Ruhollah Mostafavi Musavi Khomeini [ d ] (17 May 1900 [ c ] – 3 June 1989) was an Iranian political revolutionary and Shia cleric who served as the first supreme leader of Iran from 1979 until his death in 1989. He was the leader of the Iranian Revolution , which overthrew Mohammad Reza Pahlavi , ended the Pahlavi era , and transformed the country into an Islamic republic . As supreme leader, he implemented policies that came to be known as Khomeinism .
